notes.title: Devil's Hideout 15/09/2024 Save Game Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

For all of you who are experiencing an issue where the game doesn't find your save files, please read the following.

These instructions are only for those of you who've launched the game and can't find your save files. The rest should ignore it. 

On Windows:

Go here:
C:\Users\Enter Your User Name Here\AppData\Roaming\Devil_s_Hideout

And make a backup of your save files in a zip file / another folder. A save file reads something like this: savegame0.save.

Then go here:
C:\Users\Enter Your User Name Here\AppData\Roaming\Devil_s_Hideout_10_09_2024

Copy and paste all the save files from this folder to the original folder here:
C:\Users\Enter Your User Name Here\AppData\Roaming\Devil_s_Hideout

Now you should have access to all the missing save files.

Yours,
Cosmic Void
